verdict.rationale: The Radeon RX 9070 XT is a discrete graphics card with a compute software stack (ROCm, drivers, ML framework support). Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is an orchestration or automation-platform capability, not something buyers comparing GPUs would evaluate. Nothing in the pack shows the product or its first-party software shipping a scheduler: the HYPR-RX profiles, Docker support, and the vLLM and SGLang serving guides concern running workloads, not scheduling them on a recurring basis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
